name: gurid
description: Gurid the Great Beast, a gigantic brown cave bear rearing up on his hind legs: shaggy brown fur, a roaring head with open jaws, a black nose, white fangs and a red mouth, a frosted grey-white shaggy mane over the shoulders with broken arrows and spear shafts stuck in it, a necklace of bone fangs with a small bleached skull, pale pink scars across the chest, huge hind paws with ivory claws; he carries no weapon: he strikes with the long curved ivory claws of his RIGHT forepaw, held in front of his chest on the screen-left side, and his LEFT forepaw is raised high on the screen-right side with its claws spread
hands: he has no weapon: his right forepaw on the screen-left side strikes with its long ivory claws, and his left forepaw on the screen-right side is an empty clawed paw

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the clawed right forepaw is lifted beside the head with its long ivory claws pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the clawed right forepaw drawn back high above the head toward the upper-left, its ivory claws pointing back to the left, the left forepaw held out to the right, jaws roaring
strike.3: swing: the front hind foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the right foreleg sweeps across in front of the chest and the clawed paw reaches out level, its ivory claws pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: the right foreleg fully extended toward the lower-right, the ivory claws raking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the left forepaw swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the clawed right forepaw carries on down until its claws nearly touch the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the grey-white mane trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the clawed right forepaw comes back up on the near side toward the ready pose, the left forepaw held out to the right

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the bear's head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, jaws gaping, torso jolts back, both forelegs jerk outward (the clawed right forepaw thrown up and out to the left, the clawed left forepaw flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the clawed right forepaw dipping, the left forepaw still held up and out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the clawed right foreleg flung up, the left forepaw drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the bear's head droops, the clawed right forepaw lowering to the ground
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the claws of the right forepaw resting on the ground at the lower-right, the left foreleg hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the forelegs go limp and a broken spear shaft slips out of the grey-white mane, hind legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, hind feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, snout pointing up, the clawed forepaws limp; the broken spear shaft lies on the ground at the lower-right; the grey-white mane spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the grey-white mane settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, jaws slack, the clawed forepaws limp, the broken spear shaft on the ground beside him
